Oversee identity and access management systems, including Active Directory/Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Okta, and MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune preferred). Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans are in place, regularly tested, and maintained for all critical systems. Drive adoption of cloud and hybrid infrastructure strategies, including Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, in alignment with departmental roadmaps and campus needs. Maintain and enforce standards for OS patching, endpoint management, and system compliance across all campus-managed devices. Oversee storage infrastructure, including SAN/NAS environments and backup systems, ensuring capacity and performance meet campus demands. Security & Compliance Serve as the operational lead for network and systems security, working in partnership with campus leadership to maintain a strong security posture. Ensure consistent application of security policies, access controls, and compliance requirements across network and systems infrastructure. Lead incident response for network and systems-related security events, coordinating investigation, containment, and remediation. Develop cost estimates and scopes of work for network and systems upgrades; present findings and recommendations to departmental leadership. Manage vendor relationships, procurement, and contract activities for network hardware, software licensing, and systems infrastructure. Track and manage project budgets, purchase orders, and financial controls in adherence to campus fiscal policies. Identify and implement process improvements that increase the efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of network and systems operations. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Athletics, Academics, Facilities, Finance, and Operations to ensure network and systems solutions align with campus program needs. Serve as the hands-on escalation point for major network outages and systems incidents, actively participating in diagnosis and resolution alongside the team, while ensuring clear, timely communication with impacted stakeholders. Translate complex technical concepts and findings into clear, executive-friendly communications and reporting. Provide cross-functional support across Campus Technology teams as campus needs dictate, including AV and physical infrastructure assistance, structured cabling, and other layer 1 work, reflecting the integrated, all-hands nature of a complex, always-on campus environment.
